kannada_example: "ನೇಯುವವನು ತನ್ನ ನೇಯುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದನು."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಹರಗುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅವನು ಹೊಲದ ಹರಗುವ ಕೂಲಿ ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಕೊಯ್ಯುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ನೀಡುವ  ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಪ್ರತಿ ಎಕರೆಯ ಕಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಮುನ್ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಳಿಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ  ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಕೂಲಿಗಾರರು ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಳೆಯಲು ನಾನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೂಲಿಯನ್ನು  ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರು."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ನದಿ ಮುಂತಾದವುಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟಿಸಿದಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ನದಿ ದಾಟಿಸಿದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಬಿಗ ಜನರಿಂದ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಗಿಡ-ಮರ ಮುಂತಾದವುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಡಿಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಕೂಲಿಯವನು ಈ ಮರವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದಕ್ಕೆ ಐದು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೇಳಿದ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಗಿಡ, ಮರ ಮುಂತಾದವುಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಹಣ
kannada_example: "ಕೂಲಿಯವನು ಮರವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ ಕೂಲಿ ಐವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಕಲಾಕಾರನಿಗೆ ಅವನ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ವೇತನ
kannada_example: "ಈ ಬಾಗಿಲನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಾಡಿರುವ ಕಲಾಕಾರನ ಕೂಲಿ ಐದು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ದುಡುಮೆಗಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲ
kannada_example: "ಕೂಲಿಯವನು ಕಬ್ಬನ್ನು ಹೊರಲು  ಐನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೂಲಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಹೊಲಿಯಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅವನು ಕವುದಿ ಹೊಲೆಯುವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ನೂರು ರುಪಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಕೂಡಿಸಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ನೀವು ಈ ರತ್ನಕೆತ್ತುವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕೂಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಿರಿ?"

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಸಸಿ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಕೆಲಸದವನು ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಹತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಸಸಿ ನೆಡಲು/ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅವನು ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರುಪಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಧೂಳು ಹೊಡೆಯಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ/ಉದುರಿಸಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅಣ್ಣ ಧೂಳು ಹೊಡೆಯುವ ಕೂಲಿ ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಮನೆ ಕೆಲಸದ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅವಳು ಮನೆ ಒರೆಸುವ ಕೂಲಿ ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿಯನ್ನು ಕೆಲಸದವಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಹೊರುವ ಕೆಲಸದ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಒಂದು ಟ್ರಕ್ ಸಾಮಾನನ್ನು ಹೊರುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಬೀಸುವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಇಂದು ಒಂದು ಕೆ. ಜಿ. ಗೋಧಿಯನ್ನು ಬೀಸುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ ಎರಡೂವೆರೆ ರೂಪಾಯಿ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಒಗೆಯಲು/ತೊಳೆಯಲು ನೀಡಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಮಡಿವಾಳನು ಒಂದು ಜೊತೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ತೊಳೆಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಭೂಮಿಗೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಯಿಸಲು ಕೊಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ತೆರಿಗೆ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಮುಚ್ಚುವುದರ ಅಥವಾ ಸರಿಮಾಡುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ನಾನು ಮಾಲಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚು ಅಥವಾ ಸರಿಮಾಡುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ ಐದು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ತೂಕ ಮಾಡುವ ಅಥವಾ ಆ ಕೆಲಸದ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಎಂಬತ್ತು ಕೆ.ಜಿ. ಧಾನ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೂಕ ಮಾಡುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ ಹತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗಳು."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಅಗೆಯುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಅಂದಾಜು ಬೆಲೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ನಿಯತವಾದ ಅವಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಎಂದರೆ ದಿನಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ, ವಾರಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ, ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೊಮ್ಮೆ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕನಿಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ನೌಕರನಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಹಣ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಬೆಸೆಯುವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಹಣ ಅಥವಾ ಕೂಲಿ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಎಳೆಯುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಎಳೆಯುವುದರ ದರ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಮಾಡುವುದರ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಅವನು ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ."

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಜೀವಿಗಳು

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಹಾಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಹರಡುವ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ  ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಸಮಾರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಐವತ್ತು ಹಾಸಿಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಸಲು ಐವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ"

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ದುಡಿಮೆಗಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಮಸೆಯುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವವ

english_gloss: something that remunerates; "wages were paid by check"; "he wasted his pay on drink"; "they saved a quarter of all their earnings"
kannada_meaning: ಹಸು, ಎಮ್ಮೆ ಮೊದಲಾದವುಗಳ ಹಾಲು ಕರೆಯಲು ನೀಡುವ ಕೂಲಿ
kannada_example: "ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಪ್ರತಿತಿಂಗಳು ಹಾಲು ಕರೆದು ಇನ್ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗಳ ಕೂಲಿಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ."

english_gloss: impervious to damage by fire
kannada_meaning: ಬೆಂಕಿ ಮುಂತಾದವುಗಳು ಉರಿದು ವಿಕೃತಿ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟ ಮಾಡಲು ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ

english_gloss: care by procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury
kannada_meaning: ರೋಗವನ್ನು ಗುಣಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಲುವಾಗಿ ವೈಧ್ಯರಿಂದ ಅಥವಾ ಪಂಡಿತರಿಂದ ನಡೆಯುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ
kannada_example: "ನನ್ನ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಳೆ."

english_gloss: care by procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury
kannada_meaning: ಲೆಸರ್ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ನೀಡುವಂತ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ
kannada_example: "ಕೆಲವು ರೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಲೆಸರ್ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವಂತೆ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ."

english_gloss: not having a job; "idle carpenters"; "jobless transients"; "many people in the area were out of work"
kannada_meaning: ಜೀವನ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲು ಯಾವ ಕೆಲಸವೂ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವ

english_gloss: exchange or deliver for money or its equivalent; "He sold his house in January"; "She sells her body to survive and support her drug habit"
kannada_meaning: ಹಣವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದು ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ಏನನ್ನಾದರೂ ಬಿಕರಿ ಮಾಡು
kannada_example: "ಇಂದು ನಾನು ಐದುಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗಳ ಸಾಮಾನುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಿದೆ."

english_gloss: a flat float (usually made of logs or planks) that can be used for transport or as a platform for swimmers
kannada_meaning: ನದಿಯನ್ನು ದಾಟಿ ಹೋಗಲು ಮರದ ದಿಮ್ಮಿ ಮುಂತಾದವುಗಳಿಂದ ಚೌಕಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಅದು ನಾವೆಯ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವುದು
kannada_example: "ನಾವೆಲ್ಲರು ನೀರು ಹಾಯಿಸುವ ಬಿದರ ಹೆಡಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ನದಿಯನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದೆವು."

english_gloss: a flat float (usually made of logs or planks) that can be used for transport or as a platform for swimmers
kannada_meaning: ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಅಪಾಯ ಒದಗಿದಾಗ ದೋಣಿಯ ಬದಲು ಜನ ಅಥವಾ ಸರಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಗಿಸಲು ದಿಮ್ಮಿಗಳು, ಬೊಂಬುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವರು

english_gloss: vehicle equipped with heavy wide smooth rollers for compacting roads and pavements
kannada_meaning: ನೆಲವನ್ನು ಸಮತಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಲು ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸುವ,ಲಟ್ಟಣಿಗೆಯಾಕಾರದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಲೋಹ ಹೊಂದಿರುವಂಥ ವಾಹನ

english_gloss: utensil consisting of a cylinder (usually of wood) with a handle at each end; used to roll out dough
kannada_meaning: ಮರ, ಸ್ಟೀಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಹಿತ್ತಾಳೆ ಮೊದಲಾದವುಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾಡಿದ ಉಪಕರಣದಿಂದ ರೊಟ್ಟಿ, ಪೂರಿ ಮೊದಲಾದವುಗಳನ್ನು ಅರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ

english_gloss: a woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried
kannada_meaning: ಯಾರೋ ಒಬ್ಬರ ಹೆಂಗಸಿನ ಗಂಡ ಸತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ

english_gloss: add up to; "four and four make eight"
kannada_meaning: ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ

english_gloss: stupefied or excited by a chemical substance (especially alcohol); "a noisy crowd of intoxicated sailors"; "helplessly inebriated"
